title: AI Agent Framework Landscape Overview
content:
# Agent Framework Landscape

Agent frameworks provide the runtime, tool-calling and orchestration primitives for building research copilots.

- DeepAgents supports single-agent and orchestrator-workers execution patterns.
- Deterministic local execution enables offline evaluation without network access.
- Tool events are emitted per source family so evaluation can attribute content to Web, Catalog or Knowledge.
- Orchestration patterns differ in how work is decomposed, delegated and merged; measured baselines, not defaults, decide which fits a task.

## Orchestration patterns

- Single-agent: one agent plans, calls tools and synthesizes the answer in one loop; the flow is simple to trace and audit.
- Orchestrator-workers: an orchestrator decomposes the question, delegates bounded subtasks to workers, and merges their results; well suited to parallel source families.
- Graph orchestration: nodes and edges define an explicit pipeline; well suited to repeatable research flows.
- Multi-agent conversation: agents exchange messages toward a consensus; flexible but harder to keep deterministic.

## Offline evaluation

- Every offline number is bound to dataset/version hash, corpus ID, strategy, model, prompt and Git commit.
- Deterministic runs need no provider credentials and no network access.
- Tool events per source family make content attribution auditable.
